title: Secrets, vault drivers, Data Protection, and migration
status: SEC-014 independently GO; Gate C2 NO-GO solely pending actual macOS Keychain evidence

tasks.title: Separate provider selection from provider claims
tasks.description: Probe required native service/configuration at startup. Auto must select only a proven provider; unsupported, locked, unavailable, or headless states produce distinct diagnostics.

tasks.title: Implement/prove macOS secure storage
tasks.description: Add a Keychain-backed adapter or approved secure alternative behind the existing abstraction. Define item identity, update/delete, access scope, user interaction, concurrency, restart, and backup expectations.
tasks.status: Completed — actual macOS gate proof pending

tasks.title: Implement/prove Linux interactive secure storage
tasks.description: Add a Secret Service adapter with explicit D-Bus/session/locked-service behavior. Do not silently fall back when no graphical/session keyring exists.

tasks.title: Design the headless secure provider
tasks.description: Select and implement an explicit certificate, remote-vault, or externally supplied wrapping-key profile. It must work for service accounts without an interactive keyring and must fail closed if missing.

tasks.title: Protect the ASP.NET Data Protection key ring
tasks.description: Choose platform/profile-specific at-rest protection whose bootstrap does not depend on that ring. Keep file permissions and rotation separate from cryptographic protection.

tasks.title: Retire the insecure file-vault production path
tasks.description: Remove plaintext Base64 key generation from Auto/production, version legacy payloads, and provide an explicit development/test-only or migration disposition.

tasks.title: Build one migration state machine
tasks.description: Inventory legacy DPAPI, legacy Data Protection secret payloads, control-plane database passwords, and vault references. Stage destination, verify read, commit reference, retain source until checkpoint, then clean idempotently.

tasks.title: Implement Windows-side DPAPI migration
tasks.description: Decrypt DPAPI only on an authorized Windows host and export/re-encrypt through the selected portable provider. Include dry-run, backup, interruption, resume, and rollback.

tasks.title: Add atomicity, locking, modes, versioning, and rotation
tasks.description: Use A02 primitives for key/payload generations; verify restrictive modes; test concurrent startup, key rotation interruption, orphan cleanup, and old-generation retention.

tasks.title: Prove redaction and recovery
tasks.description: Seed sentinel secrets through success and every failure path; scan logs, exceptions, receipts, CI artifacts, migration reports, and backups for leakage.

tasks.title: Issue Security Gate C2
tasks.description: Require independent security review plus actual Windows/Linux/macOS/headless restart and migration evidence before platform composition continues.
tasks.status: Blocked — independent NO-GO pending actual macOS Keychain proof

tasks.title: Restore truthful basic local first-launch behavior
tasks.description: Use built-in DPAPI/Strong for Windows Auto and provide a supported Unix no-dependency local vault with enforced 0700/0600, typed BasicLocal protection, and a same-user warning; preserve stronger explicit providers and legacy Development compatibility, and prove first launch plus complete non-disclosure coverage on Windows and Linux.
